# Imported diagnostic frame fixtures

These eight paired declaration/inline import contracts preserve exact Pkl 0.32.0 `evaluateExpressionString` observations. Resolve, source-read, imported parse, and annotation-initialization failures retain distinct source and guest-root frame semantics.

Both fresh Java repetitions are retained as raw UTF-8 and UTF-16 bytes. `module-uri.bin` is the exact `moduleUri` field from the copied original `cases.json`, encoded as UTF-8 without an added newline. Source files and all copied payloads were verified against the original closed inventory; the original helper, report, and closure remain under `origin/`. No expected output is derived from Rust.

The Java collector's postprocessing codec-alias failure and successful offline finalizer remain described in the original report. All sixteen Java executions completed before that postprocessing failure; no Java rerun or payload normalization was used. These are API diagnostics, not complete CLI or module-loading compatibility.
